items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Now, Joe Francis Ely(?) is on the corner. He's a presser's son. He gets the kazoo, he comes around.

ctx.x: Drink wine. He's around there in the neighborhood. Charlie Costain(?).

So we're sitting on my steps. Now, Joe Francis Ely(?) is on the corner. He's a presser's son. He gets the kazoo, he comes around. Then with the ukelele, I'm drawing a crowd. I've become a little celebrity with the ukelele.
